agent_notes: The NIRF College and Overall 2025 pages each contain the exact Career College, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh row.

The official site exposes current undergraduate, postgraduate, honours-with-research, AEDP, Ph.D., short-term certificate, in-house online certificate, and certificate/diploma catalogues. Generic learning-resource labels such as Coursera, Spoken Tutorial, and Swayam-NPTEL were not imported as unnamed programmes.

The linked certificate/diploma PDF contains historical start dates but is still presented by the official certificate catalogue page as its course list; no expiry date is stated, so its named offerings are retained with official durations where provided.

Normal TLS verification failed with the exact managed-proxy self-signed-certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the supplied NIRF domains, expected search domain, and official Career College domains.

Search results were used only for official-domain discovery; all identity, district, description, and programme facts come from official pages or official linked catalogue PDFs. Career-tree mappings were checked with read-only sqlite3 queries; the database was not edited.
